cards.name: Ember Bolt
cards.text: A Heat Bolt at one enemy in range. Burns.

cards.name: Heat Shield
cards.text: A Heat Shield on yourself or an adjacent ally until your next turn.

cards.name: Frost Line
cards.text: A Cold Line that hits everyone in it and Slows them.

cards.name: Strike
cards.text: Hit an adjacent enemy with STR.

cards.name: Heavy Swing
cards.text: A big adjacent hit: STR x1.6. Deals double damage to walls and cover.

cards.name: Light Jab
cards.text: A polite adjacent poke with DEX.

cards.name: Guard
cards.text: Quick. +3 Defense and +15% Magic Resistance until your next turn.

cards.name: Dash
cards.text: Quick. +2 Movement this turn, or next turn if you've already moved or acted.

cards.name: Rally
cards.text: Allies within 3 deal +20% damage and gain +1 Movement until their next turn ends.

cards.name: Gary's Sandwich
cards.text: Quick. Heal 12 HP and 4 MP to yourself or an adjacent ally. Tastes like home.

cards.name: First Aid Kit
cards.text: Heal 18 HP to yourself or an adjacent ally. Can revive a downed ally.
